lyrics:
[Intro: pitched vocal chops, mallet percussion, snaps]

[Verse 1: playful female voice]
You saved me the good chair
You brought me the cold one
You carried my bag from the car
I see it, I see what you've done

[Chorus: bright beat, chops answering]
But use your words
I know, I know, I can tell
Use your words
I'd like to hear it as well
Three of them, any order
Use your words

[Drop: bouncing vocal chops and mallets, big drums]

[Verse 2: voice teasing, bass in]
You fixed the umbrella
You gave me the last bite
You're doing that thing with your eyebrows
Go on, it's alright

[Chorus: bright beat, chops answering]
Use your words
I know, I know, I can tell
Use your words
I'd like to hear it as well
Three of them, any order
Use your words

[Break: beat drops out, close and soft]
I can wait. I've got all day.

[Drop: vocal chops, brass swell, full drums]

[Outro: mallets, a man's voice, quiet]
"...Love. You. I."
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 100 BPM, 4/4, A major. Bright, bouncing and percussive, playful from start to finish.

VOICE: Female, light, clear and teasing, sung with a smile. Her voice is also cut into pitched single syllables that bounce through the intro and the drops. A man speaks three words, shyly, at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: Pitched vocal chops, marimba and other mallet percussion, big, roomy live-sounding drums with a heavy snare, a warm sub bass, finger snaps, bright synth plucks, a soft brass swell in the last drop, glockenspiel.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, chops and mallets. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:38 Chorus 1. 1:00 Drop 1. 1:22 Verse 2. 1:46 Chorus 2. 2:08 Break. 2:18 Drop 2, with brass. 2:44 Outro, mallets and three spoken words at 2:52.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2014 indie electronic: bright, wide and punchy, drums big and live, chops glittering on top.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The three words in the wrong order at 2:52.

STATION FIT: 11:30 a.m., late morning. Light, mid-tempo and percussive, the most playful of the daytime vocal tracks.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Teasing, patient, fond, rewarded.
